name: context-menu
title: ContextMenu
description: A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on color.bg.overlay at z.popover.

manifest.name: context-menu
manifest.title: ContextMenu
manifest.description: A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on color.bg.overlay at z.popover.
manifest.usage: Use ContextMenu for the actions of the thing under the pointer: a tree node, a grid cell, a tab. Compose it as ContextMenu > ContextMenuTrigger (the area; give it its own classes) + ContextMenuContent > ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup with ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuGroup with ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, and ContextMenuSub > ContextMenuSubTrigger + ContextMenuSubContent. A right-click is not discoverable and not available to everyone: every action in it must also be reachable another way (a toolbar, a DropdownMenu, the CommandPalette, a shortcut). For a menu behind a visible button use DropdownMenu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a right-click, an item, Escape or an outside press opens or closes it.

props.name: modal
props.description: As Base UI: the page ignores the pointer and does not scroll while the menu is open.

props.name: danger
props.description: ContextMenuItem: a destructive action in color.status.danger.fg.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: ContextMenuItem: closes the menu when chosen (false for checkbox and radio items by default).

props.name: disabled
props.description: On an item: shown in color.fg.disabled with aria-disabled; it cannot be chosen.

props.name: checked
props.description: ContextMenuCheckboxItem: controlled state; onCheckedChange reports changes.

props.name: value
props.description: ContextMenuRadioGroup: the chosen value (onValueChange); ContextMenuRadioItem: its value.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal, at the pointer, at z.popover, with the area's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="context-menu-positioner".

parts.name: ContextMenuTrigger
parts.description: The area that opens the menu on right-click or the context-menu key; a <div>, unstyled.

parts.name: ContextMenuContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner at the pointer and the menu.

parts.name: ContextMenuItem
parts.description: role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.

parts.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
parts.description: role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.

parts.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
parts.description: role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.

parts.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
parts.description: role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.

parts.name: ContextMenuLabel
parts.description: A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: ContextMenuSeparator
parts.description: role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.

parts.name: ContextMenuShortcut
parts.description: The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: ContextMenuSubTrigger
parts.description: An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.

parts.name: ContextMenuSubContent
parts.description: The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the menu grows from 95 % and fades in over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.enter; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The item under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: submenu-open
states.description: A sub-trigger whose submenu is open keeps color.interactive.hover.

states.name: danger
states.description: A destructive item: color.status.danger.fg, color.status.danger.bg when highlighted.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A disabled item: color.fg.disabled and aria-disabled; reachable but not chosen.

accessibility: The popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" and "menuitemradio" items with aria-checked; groups are role="group" named by their label.

A right-click opens the menu at the pointer; on a focused area the context-menu key or Shift+F10 opens it (the browser sends the same contextmenu event). Focus moves into the menu; arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and returns focus.
ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen.
Every action in a context menu is also available elsewhere (toolbar, DropdownMenu, CommandPalette, shortcut), because right-click is not discoverable.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.
The menu takes the area's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

meta.example:
import {
  ContextMenu,
  ContextMenuCheckboxItem,
  ContextMenuContent,
  ContextMenuGroup,
  ContextMenuItem,
  ContextMenuLabel,
  ContextMenuRadioGroup,
  ContextMenuRadioItem,
  ContextMenuSeparator,
  ContextMenuShortcut,
  ContextMenuSub,
  ContextMenuSubContent,
  ContextMenuSubTrigger,
  ContextMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/context-menu/context-menu";

const area = "flex min-h-control-lg w-full items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed border-border-strong px-inset-md text-body text-fg-muted";

/** The smallest useful ContextMenu: right-click an area for its actions. */
export function ContextMenuMinimal() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className={area}>Right-click the table “orders”</ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent>
        <ContextMenuItem>Open query tab</ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>Copy name</ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}

/**
 * A connection node in the schema tree: the actions with shortcuts, a "Copy" submenu, the tree's
 * view options as checkbox and radio items, a disabled action and a destructive one.
 */
export function ContextMenuRealistic() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className={area}>Right-click the connection “orders-prod”</ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent>
        <ContextMenuGroup>
          <ContextMenuLabel>orders-prod</ContextMenuLabel>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Connect
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Enter</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem disabled>
            Disconnect
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+D</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Open query tab
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Ctrl+T</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Refresh
            <ContextMenuShortcut>F5</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
        </ContextMenuGroup>
        <ContextMenuSub>
          <ContextMenuSubTrigger>Copy</ContextMenuSubTrigger>
          <ContextMenuSubContent>
            <ContextMenuItem>Connection id</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem>Host and port</ContextMenuItem>
          </ContextMenuSubContent>
        </ContextMenuSub>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuCheckboxItem defaultChecked>Show system schemas</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ContextMenuRadioGroup defaultValue="name">
          <ContextMenuRadioItem value="name">Sort by name</ContextMenuRadioItem>
          <ContextMenuRadioItem value="size">Sort by size</ContextMenuRadioItem>
        </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem>Edit…</ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem danger>Delete…</ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}
